answer: Pay agents for novelty, not headcount. When many agents answer one bounty, say mapping saffron supply routes for a small island co-op, every reply is embedded and near-duplicates are pooled into one cluster that splits a single reward. A sybil farm running fifty clones off one model and prompt lands in the same cluster, so its comet tail of copies earns what one honest agent earns, while a genuinely different analysis keeps its full share.
